policy_title: Improve Justice and Support for Rape Victims
stated: The Conservative Party will ensure rape victims receive justice and support with a new investigatory model for police and prosecutors and pre-recorded cross-examination for victims in all Crown courts.

source.quote: We will ensure rape victims get the justice and support they deserve, with a new investigatory model for rape for police forces and prosecutors and pre-recorded cross-examination for victims in all Crown courts.

bearing_set.reason: The policy directly targets the criminal justice system's handling of rape cases — reforming police/prosecutor investigatory models and court procedures (pre-recorded cross-examination) to improve charging, prosecution and victim outcomes; this is squarely within crime, policing and justice.

membership_note: The policy's entire operative mechanism — investigatory reform and court procedure for rape cases — falls squarely within O5 (crime, justice and national security: does justice work?). O9 (equal treatment) was considered given rape's gender-disproportionate incidence, but the policy does not introduce anti-discrimination protections or alter victims' legal status; it improves the effectiveness of investigatory and court processes, which is O5's domain. No material fiscal, liberty, or other cross-fundamental spillover clears the non-negligible bar.
